All 11 wiring cells remain open. Whole thumbnail and targeted crops inspected; no measured registration, all-routes trace, or exhaustive omission/topology claim. Two no-source origins remain unresolved; no physical pin or join inferred. Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission claims remain bounded by source review.
